scope: Current compiler reference-to-dispatch settings; metadata view of the existing ledger/owner packets, not new task IDs or implementation authorization. Package repair allocation is a separate owner plan.

policy.objective: Least expensive supported model/effort likely to meet the same independent acceptance over the full run, including context, retries/corrections and review; not a measured optimum.
policy.dispatch_defaults: No default Astra, xhigh, max or ultra for ordinary packet work. The coordinator model is unchanged.
policy.tooling_first: Do not spawn a worker just to run a cheap known command or hash files.
policy.context: Supply only selected reference/group, source-current owner declarations, independent expected outcomes, raw evidence, exact released files and command recipe. Avoid whole-history forks and repeated inventories.
policy.review: Risk-matched independent Sol review; reuse matching unchanged accepted evidence and combine overlapping witnesses only when exact source/scope matches. Do not duplicate parent/group reviews or let a shared group waive another packet acceptance.
policy.concurrency: Four conceptual owner lanes; at most three subagents beside the coordinator with the current dispatcher. Reserve a slot for an independent review when needed.
policy.ownership: One live writer per exact source file. In particular types.rs, ir.rs, js.rs, server.rs and artifact.rs are shared across groups; group labels grant no file lease. Narrow the released writer closure before concurrent dispatch. Foreign package/native/GUI/application prerequisites are retained.
policy.gates: Existing accepted/proposed/JEV/support/host prerequisites remain unchanged. Model allocation selects neither a technical policy nor a new implementation release.
policy.runtime_recheck: Recheck supported models/efforts, actual source/contracts and candidate recipe before each dispatch. Record selected pair, scope, attempts, review/corrections and available usage/time; escalate or split only with evidence.

official_sources.use: Workload choices are starting points; keep the lightest setting meeting the quality bar.
Lower effort uses fewer reasoning tokens; compare cost per successful task, not model price alone.

counts.nonadditive: Shared outcome and qualification joins are not separate new implementations or wins; OR01/OR02 retain completed witnesses plus their remaining checklist/joins.

lanes.name: Analysis, syntax and checked ownership
lanes.scope: Types/effects/resolution/recovery, stack localization, representability and source/cohort/history contracts.

lanes.name: IR, generated execution and map ownership
lanes.scope: IR/JS/BDD/UI/value/call/default/map consumers; package owners retain their foreign writers.

lanes.name: CLI, build, JSON and editor boundaries
lanes.scope: Build metadata, transport/input/output, renderer processes, docs/policy and client/workspace support.

lanes.name: Consumer profiles and release evidence
lanes.scope: Specified bodies/inventories, original application/host joins and public support crosswalks; no substitute mock acceptance.

conflict_limit: Recorded defining writers are an initial conflict index. Step9/consumer proposals may add released exact writers; recompute actual leases at dispatch rather than assuming absent files are safe.
